info.description: PharmVar now provides a beta version of a RESTful API service to facilitate convenient utilization of genes, alleles, and variants defined in the PharmVar Database served in JSON format. For information about available services, please see the documentation below. Limitations: Please limit usage to 2 service calls per second to ensure service stability for all users. The PharmVar API now requires a valid API key for access. Keys may be generated with a PharmVar Account on the Account Settings Page.

description.description: For complex alleles, a description may be provided instead of a list of variants

evidenceLevel.description: The allele evidence level. D=Definitive, M=Moderate, L=Limited

function.description: The CPIC Clinical Function for the allele

hgvs.description: The definition of the allele in HGVS notation for the RefSeqGene

legacyLabel.description: The legacy name for the allele

url.description: The PharmVar URL for the allele

variantGroups.description: The list of variant groups associated with the allele

variants.description: The list of variants associated with the allele
